description: Generic on purpose in the real source: N logos cycled through M fixed slots. The hero passes 7 logos into 5 rotating slots; the press banner passes 4 logos into 4 static slots (4 into 4 means no cycling, entrance animation only).

rotates.note: derived: true only when logoCount > slots

reveal.reverses: re-runs in reverse when the row leaves the viewport

rotation.crossfade: incoming and outgoing logos coexist for the 500ms of the same blur/fade animation

licensing: Every logo in both real instances is a third-party trademark. See assets/asset-roles.json roles brand.partner-logo and brand.press-logo.
